description: T-ENGINE-005 ordinary-client production gate for B-249/B-242/B-174/B-183. It starts a 12-bot Combat Simulator match on authored Car Park, resolves every bot to the exact base:dark_combat body 86 and base:head_dark_combat head 4 catalog identities, requires one-player-plus-12-bot publication through the canonical capsule-safe spawn policy, observes ordinary autonomous combat through stable runtime-to-config attribution receipts, and retains four gameplay captures for V-009 visual review without any Car Park-specific source branch.

input_sequence.comment: Pause virtual fixture time until the ordinary Car Park match has published one player and 12 independently spawned bots and the player is stably controllable.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_AIM_DOWN
input_sequence.comment: Exercise ordinary player control while bots remain production-AI owned.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: Exercise the ordinary combat producer path without injecting score ownership.
Exit after autonomous bot combat has had a bounded 75-second window to produce stable player/bot attribution and navigation behavior.

required_lines: PLAYER\.INIT\.PREFLIGHT match=ok players=1 bots=12 stage='base:arena_mp_carpark' scenario='base:combat'
SPAWN\.ORCH: prepare player=\d+ client=-?\d+ role=[^ ]+ pool=\d+ duplicate=0
SPAWN\.ORCH: commit player=\d+ pool=\d+ pos=\([^)]+\) room=\d+
SPAWN\.ORCH: done participants=13 pool=\d+ sectors=\d+ teams_mask=0x[0-9a-f]+
BODY\.HEADSPOT\.RESOLVED: body_id='base:dark_combat' bodynum=86 head_id='base:head_dark_combat' headnum=4 part=4
MPSTATS\.ATTRIBUTION runtime_attacker=[1-9]\d* stable_attacker=(?:[89]|[1-3]\d) attacker_kind=bot runtime_victim=\d+ stable_victim=\d+ victim_kind=(?:player|bot)
